deviations.what: t19 shipped without the approval/human-task surface: the plan's t19 entry lists approvals among the documented OpenAPI operations, but the engine (t9) does not yet create human_tasks rows for approval nodes and the worker (t12) dispatches approval kinds through a not-yet-registered HumanDispatcher seam — so the API landed runs/ledger/reviews/SSE without approval endpoints rather than inventing endpoints over missing engine support
deviations.reason: engine human-task support was an undeclared prerequisite the plan's task split missed; shipping honest scope beat shipping stub endpoints
